note: Triennial election of Newry No. 2 (County Armagh) Rural District Council, twenty-nine single-member divisions, 1952. Nominations received by W. B. O'Donoghue on Tuesday 20 May 1952; contests in Bessbrook North, Camlough and Moybane, polled Thursday 5 June 1952. No nominations for Crossmaglen, Drumintee and Moyra Castle, whose sitting members were deemed re-elected. No party labels printed. Sole candidate; no poll (no votes in the notice). Returned unopposed. The County Armagh transcription published before 7 Nov 2026 (Newry Reporter, 22 May 1952, p. 1 ("Newry No. 2 Rural Council: Three contests to take place")) read John Reid: 'John Reid, J.P.'.
